name: sme_round3_tier_separation
description: The pre-registered analysis for the round-3 blinded sample: does review_priority predict what the SME rejects? Joins the ingested 120 ratings (ko_sme_round3_sample) to the pack that carries the blinded tier labels (ko_imaging_review_pack) and tests whether rejection rises across the ordered low/medium/high tiers with the linear-by-linear association test — equal to Cochran-Armitage for the binary outcome, and run a second time keeping ACCEPTABLE < PARTIAL < WRONG ordinal, both as planned in the covering-email notes before the reviewer saw the file. The sample was blinded and stratified 40/40/40 precisely so this run would be meaningful.
